title: SAFE-Fire: code and frozen evaluation records

creators.name: Hade, Aya
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

creators.name: Kamil, Mustafa
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

description: Code, frozen evaluation records, trained weights and the records of every training run supporting a study of false alarm rates in indoor fire detection. Version 3.0.0 adds the extended study: 51 training runs in a factorial design, every earlier run re-scored with one protocol, a test suite frozen before any model was scored on it, negative-set manifests, per-image scores, threshold sweeps and the scripts that regenerate every table.
